info.title: Continuum AI IAM API
info.description: IAM contract. Password login and reset, verified email/password registration, Google OAuth login/signup, account-only sessions, Organization onboarding, current identity, logout and refresh are implemented. Authentication establishes a User identity; Organization APIs require a separate current ACTIVE membership. Browser authentication uses HttpOnly cookies through the FE BFF.

tags.name: AI Engine
tags.description: BE-authenticated integration entry points for SAG.

tags.name: Organization Memberships
tags.description: C-02 membership reads; lifecycle commands and invitation cutover remain separate.

get.summary: Continue to SAG with the current Continuum session
get.description: Validates the current Continuum session and active Organization. If it is absent or expired, redirects to the Continuum sign-in page and returns to this flow. Without projectId, BE lists only the actor's visible Projects and redirects to the SAG Project chooser. With projectId, BE revalidates access through ProjectService.get, calls SAG privately with that single Project scope, and redirects with a SAG-only short-lived token in the URL fragment. The Continuum access token is never sent to SAG or placed in the redirect URL; Project options in the fragment are display data and do not grant access.

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: A client-generated UUIDv4 retained by the SAG browser session and checked by the SAG callback page.

parameters.name: projectId
parameters.description: Optional Project selected in SAG. This value is only a request; BE checks Project access again before issuing a Project-scoped SAG session.

302.description: Redirects to Continuum sign-in when the Continuum session or active Organization is missing. Without projectId, redirects to the SAG Project chooser with visible Project options in the URL fragment. With an authorized projectId, redirects to the SAG callback with a Project-scoped SAG token in the URL fragment.

400.description: The supplied state is not a UUIDv4 or projectId is malformed.

404.description: The selected Project is not visible to this Continuum actor.

502.description: SAG returned an invalid login response or an upstream error.

503.description: The SAG login integration is not configured or SAG is unavailable.

post.description: Authenticates an eligible user and stores only a hash of the initial refresh credential. Unless an organizationId is explicitly supplied and validated, every Organization membership count (zero, one, or many) receives an ACCOUNT session without Organization or role claims so the browser can open the Organization chooser. Invalid credentials use a generic response.

Set-Cookie.description: Three separate fields: continuum_access (HttpOnly; SameSite=Lax; Path=/; Max-Age=900; Secure in production), __Secure-refresh (Secure; HttpOnly; SameSite=Lax; Path=/api/v1/auth; Max-Age=604800; no Domain), and __Host-csrf (Secure; SameSite=Lax; Path=/; no Domain; not HttpOnly). Never combine fields with commas.

post.description: Accepts a name and email only; no User or password is created before email verification. Every syntactically valid request gets the same 202 response whether the address is new, already has a password account, is ineligible, or SMTP later accepts/rejects delivery. An eligible address receives a single-use verification link with a 30-minute lifetime. The recipient chooses a password after opening the same-origin FE link. No Organization, membership, role or Platform authority is created.

202.description: Generic acknowledgement; does not confirm account existence or email delivery.

503.description: A durable pending registration or encrypted email intent could not be stored.

post.summary: Verify email and choose the account password
post.description: Accepts the one-time token from the FE URL fragment and a password chosen by the recipient. The token digest is claimed once; account creation or attaching a password to the matching ACTIVE Google-only User and token consumption commit atomically. Existing password accounts and ineligible users are not changed. No session cookie is issued; the user signs in normally.

204.description: Email verified and password credential committed; no session is created.

400.description: Token is missing, expired, superseded, already used or belongs to an ineligible account.

422.description: Malformed token or password policy violation.

503.description: Token store or account transaction is unavailable; an uncommitted verification can be retried.

post.description: Returns the same generic 202 after a valid request is durably recorded, whether or not an ACTIVE account exists or SMTP accepts delivery. A rate-limit, persistence, or encryption-key outage returns generic 503 PASSWORD_RESET_REQUEST_UNAVAILABLE. The backend rate-limits by trusted source IP and normalized email. ACTIVE accounts, including Google-only accounts that do not yet have a local password, receive a single-use link that expires after 30 minutes. MongoDB stores the SHA-256 token digest and encrypted email payload atomically; plaintext token and email content are not stored.

202.description: A generic acknowledgement. It does not confirm account existence or email delivery.

503.description: The reset token and email job could not be durably stored.

post.summary: Set a new password with a reset link
post.description: Accepts a single-use 256-bit random reset token with a 30-minute lifetime. The token must still be the current token for the account. In one MongoDB transaction, the backend changes the password for an ACTIVE account and revokes all of its refresh sessions. Invalid, expired, superseded and used tokens share one error. Existing short-lived access JWTs can remain valid until their 15-minute expiry.

204.description: Password changed; all refresh sessions were revoked.

Set-Cookie.description: Clears the current browser's access, refresh and CSRF cookies. Other active access JWTs can remain valid until their 15-minute expiry.

400.description: The reset link is invalid, expired, superseded or already used.

get.description: Starts Google OAuth authorization-code flow with PKCE, state and nonce. The backend issues a short-lived encrypted HttpOnly state cookie through the FE BFF. The OAuth callback URI is GOOGLE_CALLBACK_URL and must point to the FE /api/auth/google/callback route. Only openid, email and profile scopes are requested. Without an explicit organizationId, every membership count receives an ACCOUNT session and continues to the Organization chooser; a supplied organizationId is revalidated before Organization context is issued.

parameters.name: organizationId
parameters.description: Optional Organization selected after an earlier OAuth identity check; the backend verifies current ACTIVE membership again.

Set-Cookie.description: Short-lived encrypted __Host- OAuth transaction cookie; Secure; HttpOnly; SameSite=Lax; Path=/; no Domain.

get.description: Accepts the Google authorization response at the FE callback route. The backend checks the browser-bound state cookie, PKCE verifier, nonce, ID-token signature, audience, issuer, expiry, stable sub and verified email before creating or linking an account. A matching normalized verified email links to its existing internal User; Google sub remains the provider identity key. Active-account and MFA checks still apply. Unless an Organization was explicitly requested and revalidated, zero, one, or multiple active Organizations receive an ACCOUNT session and the browser is sent to the Organization chooser. Google signup creates no Organization, membership, role or platform authority.

302.description: Redirect to the app after login, cancellation, or a generic OAuth failure.

Set-Cookie.description: On success, separate continuum_access, __Secure-refresh and __Host-csrf cookies; always clears the OAuth transaction cookie.

post.description: Authenticates an active Human DATN User with the existing password, account-eligibility, and MFA checks. The server verifies at least one current approved PLATFORM assignment before issuing a Platform-context access and refresh session. The token has no Organization or role claims; the refresh session preserves Platform context and rechecks current assignments on rotation. This session does not grant Organization membership or permit Organization-scoped APIs. Tokens are returned only in cookies, never in JSON.

Set-Cookie.description: Three separate fields: continuum_access and __Secure-refresh are HttpOnly; __Host-csrf is readable by the browser. Cookie attributes match the Organization login route.

post.description: Backend A-02 refresh HTTP contract. The browser uses the Next.js BFF public URL at this same path. Request credentials are the HttpOnly __Secure-refresh cookie, readable __Host-csrf cookie, and matching X-CSRF-Token header; no JSON refresh-token request is accepted. Successful rotation commits before issuing replacement cookies. See the dated A-02 amendment in docs/decisions/auth-session-contract-a-01.md.

parameters.name: X-CSRF-Token
parameters.description: Matches the readable __Host-csrf cookie. NestJS validates before refresh-session mutation.

parameters.name: __Host-csrf
parameters.description: Readable double-submit CSRF cookie; Secure; SameSite=Lax; Path=/; no Domain.

200.description: Refresh credential rotated once and replacement cookies issued after transaction commit.

Set-Cookie.description: Two separate fields, never comma-joined: continuum_access (Path=/; HttpOnly; SameSite=Lax; Max-Age=900; Secure in production) and __Secure-refresh (Path=/api/v1/auth; Secure; HttpOnly; SameSite=Lax; Max-Age=604800; no Domain).

post.description: Idempotently clears access and refresh cookies at their issued paths. A presented valid access token is revoked for its remaining lifetime; a presented refresh session is revoked by hash before confirmation.

Set-Cookie.description: Separate clearing fields for continuum_access at Path=/ and __Secure-refresh at Path=/api/v1/auth.

get.description: Loads the active User from a valid cookie or bearer token. ACCOUNT context returns identity without Organization or role fields; it grants no Organization or Platform authority.

get.summary: List Organizations available to the signed-in account
get.description: Returns only Organizations with a current ACTIVE membership for the authenticated non-Platform User. The response is not itself an authorization grant.

get.summary: List the signed-in recipient's current invitations
get.description: Returns only current PENDING, unexpired V2 invitations bound to the authenticated active User ID and exact normalized account email, with the current PENDING_INVITE membership version and Organization label. Recipient DTOs exclude targetUserId, recipient email and roleCode. Results are paginated and no-store.

200.description: Current invitations addressed to the signed-in recipient.

503.description: The IAM membership persistence dependency is unavailable.

get.description: Returns the minimal recipient invitation and membership snapshot. A pending invitation whose expiresAt is at or before the current time is presented as EXPIRED without changing its stored version. The lookup is bound to authenticated User ID and exact normalized account email and is no-store.

200.description: Minimal recipient invitation and membership detail.

404.description: Invitation is missing or not bound to the current account.

503.description: The IAM membership persistence dependency is unavailable.

post.summary: Accept a current bound Organization invitation
post.description: The V2 request requires both membership and invitation versions, idempotency and the CSRF cookie/header pair. It never grants a Role or mints an Organization session. Runtime acceptance remains blocked until the A7 orphan-right evidence and coordinated A8 cutover are verified; while blocked, the endpoint returns 503 IAM_MEMBERSHIP_DEPENDENCY_UNAVAILABLE and performs no mutation.

parameters.name: __Host-csrf
parameters.description: Readable double-submit CSRF cookie; its value must match the X-CSRF-Token header.

200.description: Recipient accepted a current live invitation.

500.description: Required membership mutation write failed and was rolled back.

503.description: A7/A8 acceptance readiness is unavailable; no mutation was attempted.

post.summary: Enter an Organization from an authenticated account session
post.description: Requires a valid non-Platform ACCOUNT or Organization session and matching CSRF cookie/header. The server revalidates any current Organization membership and the user's ACTIVE membership for the requested Organization before issuing new session cookies with the selected Organization context.

200.description: Organization session issued in HttpOnly cookies.

post.summary: Create an Organization for the current account
post.description: Requires an authenticated active Human User session and valid CSRF cookie/header. Creates a FREE Organization, ACTIVE first-admin membership, ADMIN role assignment and audit record atomically. The account can bootstrap only itself; it receives no Platform authority. Rate limited to three creation attempts per hour per account.

201.description: Organization created; the caller is its first ADMIN.

get.description: Returns contract V2 pending, unexpired invitations for the scoped Organization, joined to current membership versions. Requires an ACTIVE User and OrganizationMembership plus the current ADMIN Role's organization.memberships.read permission. Role/title claims do not authorize access.

200.description: Current pending invitations in the caller's Organization.

503.description: Required membership dependency is not ready.

post.summary: Invite an account to an Organization
post.description: Contract V2 invite command. Requires the matching trusted Organization context, current ACTIVE actor membership, current ADMIN Role with organization.memberships.manage, matching CSRF cookie/header, a strict {email, reasonCode} body, and an Idempotency-Key. The email must identify an existing eligible account. When operational readiness is enabled, it creates PENDING_INVITE membership, invitation, committed operation, allowlisted audit record, and outbox intent atomically. The seven-day invitation expiry and shared 30 committed invite/resend operations per Organization/actor rolling hour are enforced server-side. An outbox intent does not prove email delivery. New invite operations currently return 503 without mutation while A7 notification-provider evidence and A8 coordinated cutover are blocked; exact committed idempotency replays remain replayable.

parameters.name: __Host-csrf
parameters.description: Readable double-submit CSRF cookie; its value must match the X-CSRF-Token header.

201.description: Membership invite command committed. Exact key replay returns the same status/body and Idempotency-Replayed: true.

429.description: The committed invitation quota was reached. Retry-After is seconds until the oldest counted operation leaves the rolling window.

503.description: A7 notification-provider evidence or A8 coordinated cutover is blocked. A new command performs no mutation; an exact committed idempotency replay returns the stored result.

post.description: Requires current Organization membership manage authority and matching CSRF cookie/header. Supersedes the current V2 pending invitation and creates its successor with membership and invitation version checks. Invite/resend quota, idempotency, audit, and outbox intent are transactional. An outbox intent does not prove email delivery. New commands currently return 503 without mutation while A7 notification-provider evidence and A8 coordinated cutover are blocked; exact committed idempotency replays remain replayable.

parameters.name: __Host-csrf
parameters.description: Readable double-submit CSRF cookie; its value must match the X-CSRF-Token header.

200.description: Invitation resend committed or exactly replayed.

503.description: A7 notification-provider evidence or A8 coordinated cutover is blocked. A new command performs no mutation; an exact committed idempotency replay returns the stored result.

post.description: Requires current Organization membership manage authority and matching CSRF cookie/header. Uses expected membership/invitation versions and atomically cancels the invitation, transitions the pending membership to REMOVED, records the committed operation, and writes audit when operationally enabled. New commands currently return 503 without mutation while A8 coordinated cutover is blocked; exact committed idempotency replays remain replayable.

parameters.name: __Host-csrf
parameters.description: Readable double-submit CSRF cookie; its value must match the X-CSRF-Token header.

200.description: Invitation cancellation committed or exactly replayed.

503.description: A8 coordinated cutover is blocked. A new command performs no mutation; an exact committed idempotency replay returns the stored result.

post.description: Requires current Organization membership manage authority and matching CSRF. Rejects self-suspension, checks ACTIVE membership and expected version, resolves eligible ADMIN through the current Role permission, serializes through the shared Organization ADMIN fence, protects the last eligible ADMIN, and writes one atomic operation/audit record.

parameters.name: __Host-csrf
parameters.description: Readable double-submit CSRF cookie; its value must match the X-CSRF-Token header.

200.description: Membership suspension committed or exactly replayed.

503.description: The membership persistence or audit dependency is unavailable; the transaction is rolled back and no success is returned.

get.description: Returns users visible in the caller's organization scope.

patch.description: Updates mutable profile or account-status fields. Only an organization Admin may change status.

post.summary: Provision an Organization and its first ADMIN
post.description: Requires the exact A-04 permission organization.create at PLATFORM scope. Creates only the Organization and its first active ADMIN membership/role assignment in one transaction. The Platform Operator is not made an Organization member or ADMIN. This operation does not grant ongoing membership/role management or content access.

201.description: Organization created with first ADMIN bootstrap and audit record committed atomically.

get.description: Requires platform.health.read at PLATFORM scope. Returns the existing IAM process liveness response only; a status of ok means the IAM health handler responded. It does not report MongoDB, Redis, BullMQ, or other dependency readiness. It does not return configuration, secrets, credentials, or Organization content.

200.description: IAM process liveness response; dependency readiness is not included.

get.description: Requires platform.audit.read at PLATFORM scope. Returns a bounded, projected subset of Organization provisioning and Platform authority lifecycle metadata only. It excludes mixed metadata, Organization security events, Project records, tokens, secrets, credentials, and private content.

200.description: At most 100 newest safe platform operational audit records.

get.description: Returns Project metadata visible to the authenticated User in the trusted Organization. Users with an ACTIVE Organization Membership may read PUBLIC Project metadata; PRIVATE Projects require the documented Project read policy. Organization Admins may list all organization Projects. Nested Project resources are outside this endpoint contract.

post.description: Any authenticated User with an ACTIVE Organization Membership in the trusted Organization Context may create a Project in that Organization. New Projects are PRIVATE. An ADMIN or TEAM_LEADER role and a project.create capability grant are not required. Creation bootstraps the creator as an ACTIVE ProjectMembership with a project-scoped MEMBER RoleAssignment, but does not make the creator a Project Leader, owner, or Team. A provisioned current MEMBER Role with project.read is required for the bootstrap; the Project, membership, assignment, and project.create audit event are committed atomically.

get.description: Returns Project metadata when the authenticated User has visibility in the trusted Organization. An ACTIVE Organization member may read PUBLIC Project metadata. PRIVATE Projects require the documented Project read policy. Nested Project resources are outside this endpoint contract.

Read-only permission check using the same authorization guard as PATCH: ACTIVE OrganizationMembership, Organization-scoped ADMIN assignment and project.visibility.manage. Returns canManageVisibility=true on 200, 403 means denied. Archived, missing and cross-organization Projects fail closed. No mutation or audit event is created. Cache-Control: no-store. A later PATCH is independently reauthorized.

patch.description: Requires ACTIVE OrganizationMembership, an organization-scoped ADMIN RoleAssignment, and project.visibility.manage in the resolved Role.permissions. Allows PRIVATE to PUBLIC and PUBLIC to PRIVATE. A request for the current visibility returns 409 after authorization succeeds. Making a Project PRIVATE revokes metadata access granted solely by PUBLIC visibility. The mutation is audited in continuum_audit.audit_logs_iam. Project content permissions are unchanged.

get.description: Requires ACTIVE OrganizationMembership, ACTIVE ProjectMembership, a matching project-scoped TEAM_LEADER RoleAssignment, and project.members.list in the resolved Role.permissions. An organization-scoped ADMIN assignment alone does not authorize member listing. Returns membership identifiers, status, and join time; it does not return user profile fields or conflate membership with role assignment.

post.description: Requires ACTIVE OrganizationMembership, ACTIVE ProjectMembership, a matching project-scoped TEAM_LEADER RoleAssignment, and project.members.add in the resolved Role.permissions. An organization-scoped ADMIN assignment alone does not authorize adding members. The target must be an active User with ACTIVE OrganizationMembership in the Project's Organization. Creates ACTIVE ProjectMembership with the current MEMBER RoleAssignment; no leader or owner privilege is added.

patch.description: Proposed only; no generic ProjectMembership PATCH is enabled in Project Access & Visibility V1. Membership changes use the explicit add/remove operations. The project.members.role.change permission is disabled and must not be provisioned. A Project Leader cannot self-escalate, assign TEAM_LEADER to another User, or change another Project Leader. This operation is not implemented.

delete.description: Requires ACTIVE OrganizationMembership, ACTIVE ProjectMembership, a matching project-scoped TEAM_LEADER RoleAssignment, and project.members.remove in the resolved Role.permissions. An organization-scoped ADMIN assignment alone does not authorize removing members. Changes an ACTIVE ProjectMembership to INACTIVE without deleting ProjectMembership or RoleAssignment history. Idempotent: an already-INACTIVE membership or repeated DELETE returns 204 without another state transition or audit event. An ACTIVE to INACTIVE change is audited in continuum_audit.audit_logs_iam.

204.description: Membership is absent from the active project view; repeated DELETE also returns 204.

post.description: Requires ACTIVE OrganizationMembership, an organization-scoped ADMIN RoleAssignment, and project.leader.manage in the resolved Role.permissions. The target must already have ACTIVE OrganizationMembership and ACTIVE ProjectMembership in this Project. Assigns the existing TEAM_LEADER Role at Project scope. The event is written to continuum_audit.audit_logs_iam.

put.description: Requires ACTIVE OrganizationMembership, an organization-scoped ADMIN RoleAssignment, and project.leader.manage in the resolved Role.permissions. Atomically changes one current Project Leader to another active Project member with a current MEMBER RoleAssignment. It changes no ProjectMembership. The continuum_audit.audit_logs_iam action is PROJECT_LEADER_CHANGED; the current contract records the affected RoleAssignment IDs but has no before/after snapshot fields.

delete.description: Requires ACTIVE OrganizationMembership, an organization-scoped ADMIN RoleAssignment, and project.leader.manage in the resolved Role.permissions. Downgrades the project-scoped RoleAssignment to the current MEMBER Role and retains ACTIVE ProjectMembership. The event is written to continuum_audit.audit_logs_iam.

post.description: The user must already have an active membership in the team's project.

delete.description: Idempotently removes the membership from the team. The containing team must exist.

204.description: Membership is absent from the team.

get.summary: List own Organization members across all four states
get.description: C-02 approved membership read contract. Authenticate an ACTIVE User in the selected Organization, revalidate ACTIVE membership and an Organization-level assignment resolving actual ADMIN with organization.memberships.read from current Role.permissions. JWT roles and manage permission alone do not grant read. Strict IDs/query allowlist; no-store; createdAt DESC then _id DESC; page/count share a scoped facet with minimal User lookup after page limit. Missing User is null; missing lifecycle migration metadata fails closed. Existing invitation APIs and membership commands are outside this implementation.

200.description: List own Organization members across all four states

500.description: Unexpected internal failure while reading Organization Memberships.

get.description: C-02 approved membership read contract. Authenticate an ACTIVE User in the selected Organization, revalidate ACTIVE membership and an Organization-level assignment resolving actual ADMIN with organization.memberships.read from current Role.permissions. JWT roles and manage permission alone do not grant read. Strict IDs/query allowlist; no-store; createdAt DESC then _id DESC; page/count share a scoped facet with minimal User lookup after page limit. Missing User is null; missing lifecycle migration metadata fails closed. Existing invitation APIs and membership commands are outside this implementation.

500.description: Unexpected internal failure while reading Organization Memberships.

refreshCookie.name: __Secure-refresh
refreshCookie.description: Opaque HttpOnly browser refresh credential; Secure; SameSite=Lax; Path=/api/v1/auth so both refresh and logout receive it; no Domain.

bearerAuth.description: Short-lived access JWT accepted for programmatic/API callers. A trusted programmatic acquisition and refresh flow is deferred; browser login returns no token JSON.

C02MembershipUnauthorized.description: Authentication is missing, invalid, expired or revoked.

C02MembershipForbidden.description: The authenticated caller lacks permission for the requested scope.

C02MembershipNotFound.description: The addressed resource does not exist or is not visible to the caller.

C02MembershipValidationFailed.description: The JSON request is understood but violates field or business validation.

RefreshInvalid.description: Generic invalid refresh credential, including known revoked-token replay. No replacement cookies.

RefreshCsrfInvalid.description: Missing or mismatched CSRF values. No refresh-session mutation or replacement cookies.

RefreshFailed.description: Internal or transaction failure. No replacement cookies or database details.

Unauthorized.description: Authentication is missing, invalid, expired or revoked.

Forbidden.description: The authenticated caller lacks permission for the requested scope.

ServiceUnavailable.description: Google OAuth is disabled until all required provider settings are configured.

NotFound.description: The addressed resource does not exist or is not visible to the caller.

Conflict.description: The request conflicts with an existing unique resource or current state. User status updates can return LAST_ACTIVE_ADMIN or SHARED_ACCOUNT_STATUS_CHANGE.

OrganizationSelectionRequired.description: A requested or legacy Organization selector could not be resolved. Default browser sign-in without organizationId issues an ACCOUNT session for every membership count and does not use this response merely to display Organization options.

ValidationFailed.description: The JSON request is understood but violates field or business validation.

TooManyRequests.description: The request exceeded the applicable rate limit.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until the caller may retry.

X-RateLimit-Limit.description: Maximum requests in the current window.

X-RateLimit-Remaining.description: Requests remaining in the current window.

X-RateLimit-Reset.description: UTC Unix timestamp when the current window resets.

ResourceId.description: Opaque resource identifier. Clients must not infer its storage format.

UtcTimestamp.description: ISO-8601 timestamp normalized to UTC with a trailing Z.

details.description: Machine-readable context. Use an empty object when no additional context is safe to expose.

password.description: 12 to 72 characters and no more than 72 UTF-8 bytes because passwords are stored with bcrypt.
12 to 72 characters, limited to 72 UTF-8 bytes because passwords are stored with bcrypt.

CurrentUser.description: An authenticated Organization product identity. Default password and Google sign-in return context ACCOUNT for all membership counts, without organizationId or roles, until the user chooses a workspace. A selected Organization session includes organizationId and the user's Organization roles; those claims never establish Platform authority.
